skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: The remote installation instruction pipes an unpinned script from a mutable branch directly into a shell, creating a critical supply-chain execution risk. Other backtick detections are Markdown formatting, while user-derived command arguments lack explicit shell-safety guidance.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap command downloads an unpinned installer and executes it immediately.
remediation.suggestion: Use a versioned release artifact, publish its checksum, verify it locally, and require explicit user approval before executing the installer.

remediation.issue: The command instructions place user-derived text into shell arguments without explicit escaping requirements.
remediation.suggestion: Pass arguments through a structured process API, or apply strict shell escaping and reject command substitutions before execution.

content.value_statement: Marketplace listings need consistent images across main, secondary, and A+ placements. This skill routes product context to Higgsfield and returns labeled result links.
actual_capabilities: Creates a main image with five secondary product images.
Creates a main image with seven A+ content modules.
Creates custom subsets from supported asset types.
Uses product images, product context, brand context, category, and visual style as inputs.
Returns labeled links for completed images.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI and an authenticated account.
Depends on a remote backend for marketplace rules, prompt enhancement, and generation.
Does not create generic product photography, video ads, or character training assets.
Does not guarantee acceptance by a specific marketplace.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Listing
use_cases.description: Generate a main image and five secondary images from product details and a reference photo.

use_cases.title: Build A+ Content
use_cases.description: Create coordinated feature, ingredient, usage, efficacy, and endorsement modules for a product detail page.

use_cases.title: Produce Client Asset Sets
use_cases.description: Generate a full listing set with consistent brand context and visual direction.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Main Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one marketplace main image for [product]. Use [reference image] and emphasize [important visible qualities].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single listing image

prompt_templates.title: Create Product Images
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a marketplace product image set for [product]. Use [reference image], category [category], and visual style [style].
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard request for a main image and secondary images

prompt_templates.title: Create A+ Modules
prompt_templates.prompt: Create A+ content for [product]. Include brand context [context], key features [features], usage [instructions], and verified benefits [benefits].
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed request for marketplace content modules

prompt_templates.title: Extend an Existing Main Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use completed main image job [job ID]. Create [asset types] with category [category], brand context [context], and visual style [style].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced custom subset based on an existing job

output_examples.input: Create a main image for a sparkling peach lemonade can.
output_examples.output: Marketplace cards ready: Main image link.

output_examples.input: Create product images for a premium skincare serum using my reference photo.
output_examples.output: Marketplace cards ready: Main image, infographic, multi-angle, detail, lifestyle, and package-content links.

output_examples.input: Create A+ modules for a reusable water bottle.
output_examples.output: Marketplace cards ready: Hero, pain points, features, ingredients, efficacy, usage, and endorsement links.

best_practices: Provide a clear product image whenever possible.
State the product category, brand context, and preferred visual style.
Verify all claims and marketplace requirements before publishing generated assets.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for video, generic photography, or character training.
Do not request unsupported or unverified product claims.
Do not execute remote installers without verification and explicit approval.

faq.question: What image sets can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create a main image, product images, A+ modules, a full set, or a custom asset subset.

faq.question: Does it need a product image?
faq.answer: A product image is preferred. Clear text details can be sufficient when the product and listing intent are unambiguous.

faq.question: Can it use an existing generated main image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a completed main image job identifier and request supported secondary or A+ assets.

faq.question: Does it guarantee marketplace compliance?
faq.answer: No. The backend applies marketplace references, but users must verify current platform rules before publishing.

faq.question: What account setup is required?
faq.answer: The Higgsfield CLI must be installed, and the user must authenticate with a Higgsfield account.

faq.question: What does the skill return?
faq.answer: It returns short labels with links to ready images. Internal prompts, model names, and job identifiers are hidden by default.
